name: Aoife Kavanagh
headline: Product Manager | Roadmapping & User-Centered Product Strategy
summary: Product Manager with 4 years of experience delivering user-focused digital products in fast-paced tech environments. Skilled in roadmapping, user research, and cross-functional collaboration to translate customer needs into actionable product features. Proven ability to manage backlogs, prioritize initiatives, and work closely with engineering and design teams to ship impactful solutions.

responsibilities: Own and maintain product roadmap for a B2B SaaS platform serving 5,000+ users
Conduct user research interviews and usability testing to identify pain points
Collaborate with engineering and design teams to prioritize and refine backlog in Jira
Define and track KPIs to measure feature adoption and product performance
Present quarterly roadmap updates to stakeholders and leadership
Supported senior PMs in gathering requirements and writing user stories
Assisted in running user research sessions and synthesizing findings into actionable insights
Maintained sprint boards and backlog grooming sessions using Jira
Coordinated with QA to ensure features met acceptance criteria before release
Analyzed user behavior data to inform product decisions
Created reports and dashboards to track key product metrics
Supported roadmap planning sessions with data-driven recommendations
Assisted product team with competitive analysis and market research
